description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AvdComboBox' that extends a UI component for selecting Android Virtual Devices (AVDs). It manages AVD list updates, interacts with Android SDKs, and integrates with Android development tools within an IDE environment.

classes.name: AvdComboBox
classes.description: An abstract UI component for selecting and managing Android Virtual Devices (AVDs) within an IDE, supporting dynamic updating and integration with Android SDKs.

methods.name: AvdComboBox
methods.description: Constructor initializing the combo box with options to add an empty element and show only not launched AVDs.

methods.name: startUpdatingAvds
methods.description: Begins asynchronous update of the AVD list, considering the current modality state.

methods.name: addUpdatingRequest
methods.description: Schedules a delayed request to update the AVD list.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels pending update requests and disposes of the component.

methods.name: doUpdateAvds
methods.description: Retrieves and filters the list of available AVDs based on current device states and user options, updating the combo box model.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the associated module.

methods.name: findAndroidPlatform
methods.description: Locates the Android platform configuration from the current module or SDKs.

methods.name: findAndroidPlatformFromModule
methods.description: Retrieves the Android platform configuration from the current module.
